description: Figure 3 is a pie chart representing the distribution of different input stimulus material types provided by journalists to LLMs. The chart is divided into 10 slices, each representing a distinct category. The slices are labeled as follows: Draft/Other (dark green, approximately 26.4%), Press Release (light green, approximately 18.7%), External News Article (dark blue, approximately 18.1%), Interview (purple, approximately 8.8%), Organizational Report (light blue, approximately 7.7%), Event Posting (brown, approximately 6.6%), Intra-agency news article (beige, approximately 4.9%), Email (red, approximately 2.7%), and Social Media Post (maroon, approximately 1.1%). The chart includes percentage labels inside or next to each slice, and the slices are arranged in descending order of size. No legend is present, but the labels and colors are sufficient to distinguish between the categories.
